body_html:
Give open-plan workstations instant focus and privacy without touching a single desk. The Divide desk-mounted panel from Global Furniture Group posts cleanly onto most desk and benching surfaces, defining personal space and softening sightlines while keeping natural light moving through the room. It is a fast, reversible way to bring order to shared offices, classrooms, and busy institutional floors.

Features

  • Tool-free post mounting — installs without drilling holes or adding hardware to the desk
  • Glazed panel creates a semi-private work zone while preserving light and openness
  • Compatible with most Global desk and benching series
  • Vertically stackable to add height where more separation is needed
  • Choice of frosted or ribbed glazing with a black or silver frame
  • Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards

Specifications

This configuration pairs an approximately 12"W x 24"H glazed Divide panel with a 12" mounting post. Frame finishes are available in black or silver, and panels can be stacked to build added privacy along a run of workstations. Backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty, with five years on textiles and electrical components.

A family-owned Canadian supplier since 1964, Brant Business Interiors helps school boards, hospitals, and municipalities outfit shared workspaces — and as an OECM-eligible supplier, eligible Ontario institutions can purchase without an open tender.
